mapping.behavior: Keep the selected provider's identity and season information when TMDB supplementation cannot identify a matching media entry. Reuse ordinary title matching and resource filtering.

native.kind: Installed indexed Linux amd64 worker and real App with owned AniList, TMDB, tracker, downloader and Lark protocol peers
observations: A verified webhook search selected an AniList TV identity, preserved the provider episode scope, and reached a live tracker request even though TMDB returned no match. The resource card showed the matching release and excluded the unrelated release.

Even with auto-download enabled for all users, the provider-only selection produced no download or subscription. Manual download and subscription responses asked for a verified native identity. The fixture saw no material fetch, downloader Add, reservation authority, download preview, or invalid media key.
native.shared_command: The same runner executed a separate download outcome fixture, which failed. This individual test passed on the first run. The unrelated failure is not credited by this evidence.

adaptations_and_open: Light-media continues to require a verified native TMDB identity for mutations. The source accepts a provider model in its search path and can also invoke source subscription recognition without a TMDB ID. Read-only provider search is implemented; the remaining write behavior has not been accepted.
